newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-NATAL CLINCH SUPERSPORT CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NATAL CLINCH SUPERSPORT CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Natal clinched the Supersport Series title to become provincial first class cricket champions of South Africa in Cape Town on Saturday.
The Supersport leaders took the one bonus point they needed to ensure they could not be overhauled by opponents and defending champions Western Province.

Natal went into the final match of the season with a 17-point cushion over Western Province who could only overhaul Natal by taking maximum bonus points from a victory while preventing Natal from taking any points.
Western Province denied the champions-elect bowling points as they piled up 433 for three declared but could not bowl out Natal for less than 150 thereby denying them any batting points.
It is Natal's second title in three seasons and overall they have won the competition -- formerly known as the Currie Cup -- 23 times since its first season in 1889/90.
Scores: Western Province 433-3 declared (Herschelle Gibbs 163 not out, Jacques Kallis 138, Desmond Haynes 83), Natal 249-5 (Derek Crookes 63 not out, Neil Johnson 52).
